composition_label: Knowledge-base answers (AI customer support) -> Deep research (Research)

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.synthetic: Must be true; all supplied fixture documents are synthetic
input.question: Nonempty string
input.topics: Nonempty unique list of nonempty canonical topic strings
input.min_sources: Integer 1..100; required distinct document IDs per requested topic
input.documents: List of objects with unique id, title, and claims
input.claim: Object with id, topic, position, statement; nonempty strings; claim id unique within document

output.faq: Question, topics, min_sources, ranked evidence, blocking_reasons, response
output.evidence: document_id, claim_id, topic, position, verbatim statement, lexical score
output.citation: document_id and claim_id identify an exact source claim
output.error: One JSON object with status=error and error message; process exit code 2

boundaries: Strict exact input fields, types, nonempty strings, unique identifiers
FAQ validates retained input fields and all evidence against original input
Answer citations must reference retrieved claims; answers must exactly quote all cited evidence
Deep stage accepts only a validated FAQ handoff and synthesizes solely its evidence
Final envelope revalidates FAQ and deep synthesis
CLI rejects duplicate JSON keys, nonstandard JSON constants, invalid encoding, malformed input and file errors

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Validated question, requested topics, minimum source threshold, full retrieved evidence, blocking reasons and answer/abstention
cross_stage_handoffs.use: Group retained evidence by topic and canonical position; preserve citations and FAQ status; expose competing positions, missing evidence and inadequate corroboration
cross_stage_handoffs.abstention_behavior: Research continues over retained evidence even when FAQ abstains; it does not invent a replacement answer
cross_stage_handoffs.source_access: Original input is used only to verify handoff integrity; synthesis itself reads only the validated FAQ output

behavior.retrieval: Exact requested-topic filtering, descending question/title/statement lexical token overlap, deterministic document and claim ID tie breaks. Zero-overlap claims remain eligible when their canonical topic matches.
behavior.grounding: Extractive answers quote all relevant source statements and cite exact source claim IDs.
behavior.abstention: Any requested topic with no evidence, insufficient distinct document IDs, or multiple canonical positions blocks the complete FAQ answer.
behavior.synthesis: For each topic, group positions, deduplicate statement text, count distinct documents, retain claim-level citations; report every competing position without majority voting.
behavior.unresolved: Identify missing evidence, insufficient corroboration, conflicting authority, and the upstream abstention reason.
behavior.injection: Optional run_pipeline(data, answerer=callable) or faq_stage(data, answerer=callable). Callable receives a deep copy of retrieval context and returns an answer object subject to identical grounding validation. Fixture callables test valid, invented, invalid-citation and blocked-answer behavior.
behavior.determinism: No timestamps, randomness, network access, hidden state or live providers in pipeline output.
behavior.example: Synthetic return-window conflict produces FAQ abstention, two competing return positions and corroborated refund timing.

included: One integrated CLI and importable Python pipeline
Shared validation and stable citation lineage
Grounded extractive answers and explicit abstention
Evidence synthesis, disagreement and unresolved questions
Offline optional callable injection with fixture validation
excluded: Live providers, web research, network calls and external packages
Embeddings, semantic interpretation or natural-language contradiction detection
Automatic extraction of claims from unstructured documents
Source truth verification, source independence checks or authority ranking
Authentication, persistence services and enterprise production hardening
limitations: Caller-supplied canonical topics and positions define relevance and disagreement; text is not semantically verified against those labels.
Distinct document IDs are counted as sources, not proof of independent provenance.
Extractive grounding proves source attribution, not factual truth.
An injected callable is trusted executable Python, not a sandboxed plugin; only its output is validated.

coverage: Empty evidence and missing requested topics
Invalid input types, bounds and duplicate IDs
Valid and invalid injected callable fixtures
CLI success, usage errors and missing files
Malformed JSON, invalid schema, duplicate keys and nonstandard constants
